v1: He didn't send the long message.
And psychology says the men who let go the quietest are often the ones who loved the hardest.
v2: The moment you stop chasing, something strange happens.
Your attention was always there, so it was invisible.
Now it's gone. So it's everything.
v3: A man who begs for love is asking her to value him more than he values himself.
The man who never begs isn't cold.
Love you have to beg for was never love.
v4: They hurt you, and they expected a scene.
You stayed kind. You got better.
And that silence said more than any words ever could.
